'''Gina del Rio''' (born 26 January 2004) is an Andorran [[Cross-country skiing (sport)|cross-country skier]]. She represented Andorra at the [[2026 Winter Olympics]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/athletes/gina-del-rio |title=Gina del Rio |website=[[Olympics]] |access-date=11 May 2026}}</ref> In 2024, she was crowned Junior World Champion in the freestyle sprint event.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.proxcskiing.com/traditional-skiing/brilliant-gina-del-rio-wins-the-junior-world-championships-sprint-in-planica/ |title=Brilliant Gina Del Rio wins the Junior World Championships sprint in Planica |website=ProXCSkiing |access-date=11 May 2026}}</ref> The next year, she won silver in the classic sprint in the U23 division of the [[2025 Nordic Junior World Ski Championships]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.andorraesportiu.com/gina-del-rio-subcampiona-mundial-u23-en-lsprint-de-schilpario/ |title=Gina del Rio, subcampiona mundial U23 en l'sprint de Schilpario |website=Andorra Esportiu |access-date=11 May 2026}}</ref>
